name: web-multicolour-beauty-salon-site-with-pink-lime-and-blue-bands
title: Beauty-salon site in pink, lime and periwinkle bands with photo cards and giant closing wordmark
whatItIs: Two page columns of a salon site: hero with a face painted with yarn lines and an uppercase headline, service cards in lime, blue and pink, offer tiles, three numbered colour strips, master profile cards grouped by coloured sections, feedback with lime quote card, a booking form on periwinkle with a portrait, an FAQ list, a lime map card and a pink footer with a giant black 'LUMORA'.
whatItMeans: Energetic and youthful; saturated colour blocks mirror vivid makeup.
techniques: Assign each section its own saturated colour.
Use rounded cards with photos and round arrow buttons.

vocabulary.definition: Each section in a distinct brand colour.
An oversized brand name at the bottom.
